title: Section 2 Personnel Eligibility Verification — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for the VERAS Section 2 review at the University of Idaho: extract every PI / Co-PI / Senior Key Person, verify employment via Banner NBAJOBS, cross-reference PI / Co-PI job titles against APM Section 45.22 eligibility criteria, compile timesheet org codes, map org codes to Departmental Grant Administrators (DGAs), and cross-reference required DGAs against Section 2 participants. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping section2-personnel-eligibility workflow.

section_21_personnel.description: PI and Co-PI personnel from VERAS Section 2.1. Required by source workflow. Must contain at least one entry (every proposal has a PI). Resolves to UDM Personnel.First_Name / Personnel.Last_Name.

section_22_personnel.description: Senior / Key Personnel from VERAS Section 2.2A. Empty array when Section 2.2A is not populated.

pi_copis_requiring_eligibility.description: Names from section_21_personnel that require APM 45.22 eligibility verification.

personnel_requiring_org_code_only.description: Names from section_22_personnel that need org-code collection but NOT eligibility checks.

personnel_verification.description: Per-person Banner NBAJOBS verification records, one entry per person on the combined personnel list.

current_employee.description: True when the Banner record shows active employment; null when found_in_banner is false.

job_title.description: Banner job title verbatim; null when found_in_banner is false.

timesheet_org_code.description: Banner timesheet organization code verbatim; null when found_in_banner is false.

notes.description: Disambiguation notes, terminated-employee flags, external-collaborator flags.

eligibility_check.description: Per-person APM 45.22 eligibility records for PI / Co-PI only. Senior / Key Personnel are NOT emitted here.

job_title.description: Banner job title verbatim; null when no Banner record exists.

eligibility_status.description: Eligible = job title explicitly listed in APM 45.22; Not Eligible = job title not in APM 45.22; Review Required = ambiguous or conditional eligibility.

evidence.description: Short citation or rationale supporting the determination.

org_code_compilation.description: Unique timesheet org codes across all personnel. One entry per unique code.

dga_mapping.description: Org-code-to-DGA mapping, one entry per unique org code. Multiple DGAs per org code are supported.

department_name.description: Department name from the Department List; null when the org code has no Department List entry.

dga_names.description: DGA names from the Department List. Empty array only when the org code is not in the Department List.

dga_cross_reference.description: Per-DGA cross-reference against VERAS Section 2 participants. One entry per unique DGA pulled from dga_mapping.

enum: FLAG — Must be added to Section 2
action_needed.description: No action needed = DGA already in Section 2; FLAG = DGA required by org-code mapping but missing from Section 2.

unmapped_org_codes.description: Org codes that did not appear in the Department List.

notes.description: Source-document warnings (missing Banner extract, missing Department List, ambiguous matches).
